exposure: Induction of labor in the setting of severe small for gestational age (SGA)
cohort: 140 mothers with a single fetus in cephalic presentation with severe SGA (< 3rd centile) needing foetal extraction after induction of labor
finding: Induction of labor in the setting of severe SGA before 37 weeks' gestation allowed for vaginal delivery in two-thirds of cases, but was accompanied by a doubling of the risk of moderate or severe neonatal acidosis.
